ar.title: ساندويتش سلطة البيض
ar.intro:
قشّر البيض بنفسك واهرسه لساندويتش لذيذ.

أضف قليلاً من الشبت أو البصل الأخضر.

steps.n2: الشخص الكبير يضع البيض في ماء بارد حتى يبرد.
steps.n3: اطرق البيضة على الطاولة، ثم قشّرها. ممتع!
steps.n6: افرد سلطة البيض على شريحة توست.
steps.n7: ضع ورقة خس وغطّها بشريحة أخرى.

en.title: Egg Salad Sandwiches
en.intro:
Peel and mash the eggs yourself for a yummy sandwich.

Add a little dill or spring onion.

steps.n1: A grown-up boils the eggs for 10 minutes.
steps.n2: The grown-up puts the eggs in cold water to cool.
steps.n3: Tap the egg on the table, then peel it. Fun!
steps.n4: Mash the eggs with a fork in the bowl.
steps.n5: Add the yogurt, salt and cumin, and stir.
steps.n6: Spread the egg salad on a slice of bread.
steps.n7: Add a lettuce leaf and put another slice on top.
steps.n8: Cut it into fun shapes with a cookie cutter!

legacySteps: A grown-up boils the eggs for 10 minutes.
The grown-up puts the eggs in cold water to cool.
Tap the egg on the table, then peel it. Fun!
Mash the eggs with a fork in the bowl.
Add the yogurt, salt and cumin, and stir.
Spread the egg salad on a slice of bread.
Add a lettuce leaf and put another slice on top.
Cut it into fun shapes with a cookie cutter!
